items.w2_rec1: Symptom: The connector pins showed poor contact during the retest. Action: Cleaned the connector and reseated the cable. Result: The contact test passed with no further abnormality.
items.w2_rec2: Symptom: The thermal image showed an unusually hot spot near the regulator. Action: Replaced the regulator and repeated the thermal check. Result: The thermal image was normal after the replacement.
items.w2_rec3: Symptom: The EEPROM data was inconsistent with the reference board. Action: Rewrote the EEPROM after confirming the correct configuration. Result: The board passed verification with the corrected data.
